simplesounds.option.globalLevel.tooltip: Own intensity when following is disabled or Simple Visuals is unavailable. Off/Subtle/Normal/Strong/Maximum: 0/0.35/0.6/0.8/1 gain. Default: SUBTLE.
simplesounds.option.volumeCap.tooltip: Hard limit 0–0.25; Vanilla ambient slider also applies. Default: 0.25.
simplesounds.option.soundsPerPlayer.tool: 0–2; only your player is observed. Default: 1.
simplesounds.option.cooldownTicks.toolti: 20–1200 ticks per effect/player; mapping intervals also apply. Default: 40.
simplesounds.option.footstep_dust.toolti: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.powder_snow.step; at least 20 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.05, pitch 1.35–1.45. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.cold_breath.tooltip: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:entity.player.breath; at least 160 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.06, pitch 0.85–0.95. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.fireflies.tooltip: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.firefly_bush.idle; at least 100 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.10, pitch 0.95–1.05. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.pollen.tooltip: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.flowering_azalea.step; at least 120 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.05, pitch 1.35–1.45. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.fire_sparks.tooltip: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.campfire.crackle; at least 60 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.08, pitch 0.95–1.05. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.water_ripples.toolti: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:entity.generic.swim; at least 40 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.05, pitch 1.25–1.35. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.water_droplets.toolt: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.pointed_dripstone.drip_water; at least 60 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.08, pitch 1.05–1.15. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.leaf_fall.tooltip: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.leaf_litter.step; at least 100 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.06, pitch 1.15–1.25. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.enchanted_items.tool: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.amethyst_block.chime; at least 200 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.05, pitch 1.45–1.55. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.beacon_aura.tooltip: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.beacon.ambient; at least 200 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.06, pitch 0.95–1.05. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.damage_feedback.tool: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:entity.player.hurt; at least 40 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.10, pitch 0.75–0.85. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.healing_feedback.too: Local Vanilla sound minecraft:block.amethyst_block.resonate; at least 40 ticks apart and never sooner than the effect cooldown, base volume 0.12, pitch 1.55–1.65. Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.title: Simple Sounds
simplesounds.option.followVisuals.toolti: Use the Simple Visuals intensity when available. Effect overrides take priority; otherwise your own level applies. Client only. Default: true.
